lines.rooftop.title: ROOFTOP
lines.rooftop.title.how: Climb with {key:jump}  take the gem  stay unseen
lines.rooftop.goal.climbing: Climb: up, and jump to leap
lines.rooftop.goal.down.text: Back to the street with it

notes.rooftop.title.how: Three short hints on the title, two spaces apart, shown in capitals. {key:jump} is the player's key or button for jump.
notes.rooftop.hud.seen: A bar that fills while the guard sees you.
notes.rooftop.end.won: You stole the gem and got away.

brief: Rooftop: a short night-time heist in a small town square. The player, a hooded thief whose gender is never said, climbs onto a roof, takes a gem and gets back to the street without the guard seeing them. The words are terse game instructions; address the player with the familiar "you".
